notes.title: Patch #6: Final Update Before v1.0!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch #6 is here — and it's a big one![/h1]

[b]This will be the [u]last patch before version 1.0[/u][/b], marking the end of Early Access and the beginning of a new chapter with a [b]rebranding, a new title, and the final polish![/b]

It’s been many months since the last update. A lot has happened, both professionally and personally, but throughout it all I’ve kept working — [i]quietly but steadily[/i] — on this new patch.

The game has been [b]reworked in many areas[/b], and it took time, but it’s finally shaping up into the vision I’ve always had in mind: [b]an arcade football game with simulation elements, completely free of rails or scripts.[/b]

[h2]What's new in this version?[/h2]
[i]In short: almost everything![/i]

[list]
[b]🧠 Two new game modes[/b]
- [i]Coach Mode[/i]: watch your team play and give tactical instructions
- [i]Simulation Mode[/i]: directly simulate match results
[b]⚽ Overhauled gameplay[/b]: balanced, smoother, and more responsive
[b]🧠 AI largely rewritten[/b]: CPU teams behave more convincingly
[b]🧤 Improved goalkeepers[/b]: more reliable and proactive in 1v1 situations
[b]🏃 New stamina system[/b]: monitor player fitness and make meaningful substitutions
[b]💥 Physical collisions implemented[/b]: tackles feel solid; strong players make a difference
[b]🏆 Two new competitions added[/b]
[b]🌍 Three new leagues added[/b]: Colombia, Uruguay, and Czech Republic
[b]🔄 All rosters updated to the current season[/b]
[b]🚀 General performance improvements[/b]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[b][i]We’re finally heading into the home stretch,[/i][/b] and I [b]can’t wait to finish this game[/b] — it’s been a journey of passion, hard work, and determination.

[u]Thank you for your continued support![/u]
[b]Let’s get ready for version 1.0! 🙌[/b]

notes.title: 🎉 Active Soccer Patch #5 Released! ⚽
notes.content:
[h1]⚽ Hello Everyone! ⚽[/h1]

It's been a long time since our last patch, and so much has happened since then. But I won't bore you with the details and will get straight to the point.

[b]We are thrilled to announce the release of Patch #5! 🎉[/b]

We've reworked many aspects of the game, added new features, and introduced game modes that weren't initially planned but were highly requested by our players.

The world of Active Soccer is now more vibrant than ever! CPU-managed teams now analyze player performance to create dynamic line-ups, allowing players to develop or decline in their abilities over time. This also impacts national teams, which will now call up the most in-form players. 🌍

As per your requests, we've introduced two new game modes:

[h2]What's New:[/h2]

[list]
    [*][b]Coach Game Mode:[/b] 📋 Watch your team play and make tactical adjustments.
    [*][b]Results Only Game Mode:[/b] 📊 Simulate the final results directly.
    [*][b]Goalkeepers Reworked:[/b] 🧤 Goalkeepers are now more reliable in saves and coming out.
    [*][b]Improved AI:[/b] 🤖 The AI now plays a more fluid and convincing style of soccer.
    [*][b]Stamina Management:[/b] 💪 Stamina management has been rewritten, making player rotation crucial in Career Mode.
    [*][b]Real-Time Stamina Display:[/b] ⏱️ You can now see the current stamina levels of players in real-time.
    [*][b]Auto Lineup Feature:[/b] 📝 Automatically field the ideal formation based on player value and form.
    [*][b]Dynamic CPU Team Formations:[/b] 📈 CPU-managed teams now field the most in-form players based on performance.
    [*][b]National Team Selections:[/b] 🌟 National teams will call up players who have performed best throughout the year.
    [*][b]Updated Rosters for 2024:[/b] 📅 All team rosters have been updated to reflect the 2024 season!
    [*][b]Enhanced UI Navigation:[/b] 🖥️ Improved navigation and button prompts based on the controller used.
    [*][b]Removed Away Goals Rule:[/b] 🚫 The away goals rule has been removed as it is no longer used in competitions.
    [*][b]Various Bug Fixes[/b] 🐛
[/list]

We believe we are now very close to the final release.

As always, we appreciate your valuable feedback. Let us know what you think! 📣

Happy gaming! 🎮

notes.title: Active Soccer 2023 - Patch #4 is now live!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce the release of patch #4 for Active Soccer 2023! This update is primarily centered around enhancing the overall gameplay experience, with a strong emphasis on improving AI behavior and refining controls. Additionally, we've implemented a preliminary round of optimization, with a more substantial optimization slated for the 1.0 release.

I believe that with this patch, the gameplay now aligns perfectly with my vision for a classic arcade football experience that stands out by incorporating a touch of realism. Whether you prefer the finesse of tiki-taka, the thrill of through balls, the power of long balls, or the strategic prowess of a counter-attack, this game caters to your preferred style of play.

I acknowledge that the game isn't flawless, and I'm committed to ongoing enhancements. Your feedback is invaluable, and I'm eager to address any areas that can be further refined.

Regarding game optimization, our initial target was a system similar to the PS4, with a GTX 1060 being the recommended graphics card. However, I understand that not everyone has a dedicated gaming rig. In this patch, we've introduced some optimizations, but given that the game is built on the Unreal Engine, it may still be demanding for non-gaming computers. Rest assured, a major optimization overhaul is in the works for the final version.

What's new:
[list]
[*] 2023-24 Season data update!
[*] Game optimization and new graphic settings
[*] Improved gameplay
[*] Rewritten AI of the CPU opponent
[*] Improved responsivity of the controls
[*] There are now 5 game speeds
[*] Increased and tweaked footballers speed
[*] Improved Goalkeepers AI 
[*] Improved ball aftertouch
[*] Improved sliding tackles
[*] Improved stamina management
[*] Added an option to toggle the dash effect indicator
[*] New tournament: south american clubs cup
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Together, we're shaping this game into something truly special. Enjoy playing, and I look forward to hearing your thoughts on these improvements!

notes.title: Active Soccer Patch #3 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I hope this message finds you well. It's been quite a journey for me, facing some challenging and tiring times (including the struggles I encountered while working on these replays! :-) ). But, I'm excited to announce that the long-awaited Patch #3 is finally on its way.

In addition to the replays, a significant highlight of this update is undoubtedly the brand new management of "aerial challenges." I've completely rewritten the high-pass mechanics and overhauled the entire logic for ball reception and aerial duels. The controls have been enhanced and are now more precise than ever. Moreover, you'll find that you can now put more pronounced and arcade-like trajectories on the ball.

One particularly intriguing addition is the manual player selection using the right stick, along with the ability to command your goalkeeper to advance by pressing the Y button. I've also taken the time to revamp ball deflections, addressing several issues in the process.

I genuinely believe that this is a substantial patch, and it brings us closer to the much-anticipated 1.0 release. Your patience and support have been invaluable throughout this process.

I sincerely hope you enjoy the efforts I've put into these improvements. Your feedback and enthusiasm drive me to keep enhancing the game. Looking forward to your thoughts and experiences with Patch #3!

Best regards, Gianluca

notes.title: Patch #2 is out!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We are thrilled to announce that the Active Soccer 2023 patch #2 has just gone live! This patch is all about improving gameplay and making the game even better than before. We have added some fantastic features that will take your gaming experience to the next level.

Our major focus was on improving aerial balls, reworking goalkeepers, and enhancing pass and pass reception. Overall, we are confident that these changes will create a more fun and immersive game that will leave you wanting more.

We are excited to bring you more updates as we continue to tweak and improve Active Soccer 2023. Keep an eye out for patch #3 in the upcoming weeks!

Here is a list of the exciting new features and improvements in our latest update:

New Features:
[list]
[*] Full manual movement (when not in ball possession) by pressing left shoulder.
[*] Additional radar position (bottom center).
[*] Extra match lengths: 15 and 20 minutes.
[*] Reworked goalkeepers.
[*] New aerial balls.
[*] Reworked controls accuracy.
[*] Reworked through pass.
[*] Reworked 1-2 pass.
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed Cup Asia, Cup America, Cup Africa save crash.
[*] Improved manual player selection.
[*] Darker and more present ball shadow.
[*] Adjusted radar size.
[*] Improved high pass.
[*] Improved pass reception.
[*] Saved sound fx and crowd volume.
[*] Improved local multiplayer.
[*] Adjusted players' hair color.
[*] Fixed custom player name on shirt.
[*] Better quit game (we received bad reviews only for the quit button!).
[*] Saved alternative controls.
[*] Added Active Soccer Windows icon.
[*] Fixed end of the half goal keeper walking animation.
[*] Enhanced main menu navigation.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these updates and stay tuned for more exciting changes to come! Cheers!
